Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional desk lamp with a sturdy clamp, a surprisingly bright lowest setting, and a power button that is hard to find in the dark. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I clamped this lamp to my drafting table, and the sturdy grip hasn’t budged. But the lowest brightness still feels surprisingly bright—too much for late-night reading. And that power button? Nearly invisible in the dark. I fumble every time. Good light, annoying controls.
